# Grafana

Skills that teach agents to work with Grafana. They are copied from the vendor's repository, [grafana/ai-marketplace](https://github.com/grafana/ai-marketplace), at commit `6c28ba1`.

MCP server for AI-assisted Grafana dashboard, datasource, alerting, and incident management.

## Install

- **BoldCreate Connect:** open **Marketplace**, find **Grafana**, and click **Install**.
- **Cursor:** add this repository as a team marketplace, then install **Grafana**.
- **Claude Code:** `/plugin marketplace add syncfusion/BoldCreate-Plugins`, then `/plugin install grafana-mcp@boldcreate-plugins`.

## Skills

1 skill: `grafana-mcp-tools`.

## Setup

No install-time settings.

## Before you install

It ships no scripts. The skills are guidance for the agent.

The skills mention these environment variables for credentials: `GRAFANA_API_KEY`, `GRAFANA_PASSWORD`. This plugin does not store them.

## Docs

- Vendor repository: https://github.com/grafana/ai-marketplace
